title: SSO: from the portal's "Open console" to /bookings
caption: PADR-0007. Code: platform/frontend/src/app/(app)/otas/[tenantId]/console/launch/route.ts, ota/admin/src/app/sso/route.ts, ota/backend/src/identity/staff/staff-auth.service.ts.

steps.label: mint a portal token for the membership
SET ptk:<sha256> {accountId, tenantId, membershipId, mfa} EX 60 NX
hand-off page: auto-submitting form, Referrer-Policy strict-origin
POST /sso portalToken=ptk_… (x-www-form-urlencoded)
steps.note: Origin must be PUBLIC_PORTAL_URL (403), body ≤ 1 KiB (415/400), token ^ptk_[A-Za-z0-9]{24,64}$

steps.label: console.auth.signIn {grantType: portal_token} — X-Api-Key only, X-Velexis-Environment: test, End-User-IP/Agent
platform: membership, account, tenant active (read only); MFA for a live tenant
ConsoleStaffSession: tokens, staff, tenant, permissions, environments
steps.note: Refusals: 401 PORTAL_TOKEN_INVALID, 403 STAFF_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE, 403 TENANT_SUSPENDED, 403 MFA_REQUIRED, 429, 503 → plain HTML error page with "Back to the portal"
